name: highway
title: Highway
description: Weave through highway traffic at speed: a driving game with real car handling, traffic that drives like traffic, near misses that build combos, and a garage of seventeen cars to buy, paint and upgrade. Five places under photographed skies, from a cloudy countryside to a night run.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the game is: engine, traffic, music.

store.tagline: Weave through highway traffic at speed

actions.title: Drive
actions.description: Up is the gas, down the brake, left and right steer; WASD too.

actions.title: Change the view
actions.description: Chase, far, or from the bumper.

actions.title: In the garage
actions.description: Up and down pick a line, left and right change it, Enter buys, Space drives.

features: Cars that drive like cars: tyres that grip and slide, weight that shifts under the brakes, an engine with real gears; the body squats, dives and leans
Traffic with drivers: they keep their distance, brake, signal and change lanes when it's safe, and react when you cut in
Pass close above 100 km/h for a near miss, graded by the gap you left; near misses within four seconds build a combo
Endless on four lanes going your way, or Two-Way, where the oncoming side pays three times and touching it ends the run
Seventeen cars from a city car to a V12, each with engine, handling and brake upgrades and twelve paints
Five places under photographed skies: Countryside, High Noon, Golden Hour, Grey Day and a Night Run with headlights

screenshots.caption: 196 km/h through countryside traffic in the Stinger '96, the drivers signalling and keeping their gaps
The garage: your car drives the road behind a sign where you choose it, paint it, upgrade it and pick the place
A night run: headlights on the road, tail lamps ahead, brake lights when a driver slows
Two-Way at high noon: the oncoming side pays three times, and touching it ends the run
The end of a run: what you hit and how fast, the score, the near misses and the cash it paid
